title: Add Rolldown Configuration to a project
description: Add Rolldown Configuration to a project.

project.x-prompt: What is the name of the project to set up Rolldown for?

main.description: Path relative to the workspace root for the entry file. Defaults to `<projectRoot>/src/main.ts` if it exists, otherwise `<projectRoot>/src/index.ts`.

outputPath.description: Path relative to the workspace root for the output directory. Defaults to `<projectRoot>/dist` in TypeScript solution workspaces, otherwise `dist/<projectRoot>`.

tsConfig.description: Path relative to the workspace root for the tsconfig file used to resolve TypeScript options. Defaults to `<projectRoot>/tsconfig.app.json` or `<projectRoot>/tsconfig.lib.json`, whichever exists.

externalDependencies.description: Leave `dependencies` from package.json out of the bundle so they load from `node_modules` at runtime. Defaults to `true` for the `node` platform.
